options.en: Give nitroglycerin after a 500 mL fluid bolus
options.zh: 先输500毫升液体再给硝酸甘油

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin is contraindicated with a systolic BP below 110 mmHg. Other contraindications are known nitrate allergy or sensitivity, HR below 50 or above 150, and Viagra or Levitra within 24 hours or Cialis within 48 hours.
questions.explanationZh: 收缩压低于110毫米汞柱时禁用硝酸甘油。其他禁忌包括已知硝酸盐类过敏或不耐受、心率低于50或高于150，以及24小时内使用过万艾可或艾力达、48小时内使用过希爱力。

questions.questionEn: A 56-year-old man has chest pain, BP 128/78, HR 82. He mentions he took a Cialis tablet about 30 hours ago. What is the correct decision?
questions.questionZh: 一名56岁男性胸痛，血压128/78，心率82。他提到大约30小时前服用过一片希爱力。正确的决定是什么？

options.en: Withhold nitroglycerin: Cialis within the past 48 hours is a contraindication
options.zh: 不给硝酸甘油：48小时内使用过希爱力是禁忌证

options.en: Give nitroglycerin, since more than 24 hours have passed
options.zh: 给硝酸甘油，因为已超过24小时

options.en: Give nitroglycerin at half the usual dose
options.zh: 按常规剂量的一半给硝酸甘油

options.en: Give nitroglycerin only if the systolic BP is above 150 mmHg
options.zh: 只有收缩压高于150毫米汞柱时才给硝酸甘油

questions.explanationEn: The contraindication window differs by drug: Viagra or Levitra within 24 hours, but Cialis within 48 hours. At 30 hours post-Cialis, nitroglycerin is contraindicated because of the risk of profound hypotension.
questions.explanationZh: 不同药物的禁忌时间窗不同：万艾可或艾力达为24小时内，而希爱力为48小时内。服用希爱力30小时时仍属禁忌期，给药有导致严重低血压的风险。

questions.questionEn: A 61-year-old woman with chest pain has received 3 doses of nitroglycerin over 15 minutes. Her pain persists and her BP is now 106/70. What is the next step?
questions.questionZh: 一名61岁胸痛女性在15分钟内已接受3剂硝酸甘油，疼痛仍未缓解，目前血压106/70。下一步是什么？

options.en: Give a fourth dose of nitroglycerin immediately
options.zh: 立即给第4剂硝酸甘油

options.en: Administer Entonox 5 minutes after the last dose of nitroglycerin
options.zh: 在最后一剂硝酸甘油后5分钟给予Entonox

options.en: Administer a second 160 mg dose of ASA
options.zh: 再给一次160毫克阿司匹林

options.en: Give Entonox immediately, without waiting
options.zh: 不必等待，立即给予Entonox

questions.explanationEn: If pain persists beyond 3 doses of nitroglycerin, or if the systolic BP falls below 110 mmHg, administer Entonox 5 minutes after the last dose of nitroglycerin. Nitroglycerin used in the last 5 minutes is a contraindication to Entonox. Continue assessment and vitals every 5 minutes.
questions.explanationZh: 若3剂硝酸甘油后疼痛仍持续，或收缩压降至110毫米汞柱以下，应在最后一剂硝酸甘油后5分钟给予Entonox。5分钟内使用过硝酸甘油是Entonox的禁忌。同时每5分钟复评并测量生命体征。

questions.questionEn: How frequently should assessment, treatment and vital signs be repeated during the cardiac chest pain protocol?
questions.questionZh: 在心源性胸痛方案执行过程中，评估、处置和生命体征应多久重复一次？

options.en: Every 15 minutes
options.zh: 每15分钟

options.en: Only on arrival and at handover
options.zh: 仅在到达时和交接时各一次

options.en: Every 20 minutes
options.zh: 每20分钟

options.en: Every 5 minutes
options.zh: 每5分钟

questions.explanationEn: The protocol directs continuing with assessment, treatment, and vital signs every 5 minutes, both when pain returns after relief and when pain persists beyond 3 nitroglycerin doses.
questions.explanationZh: 方案要求每5分钟继续进行评估、处置和生命体征测量，无论是疼痛缓解后再发，还是3剂硝酸甘油后疼痛仍持续的情况。

questions.questionEn: A 73-year-old man's chest pain resolved completely after 2 doses of nitroglycerin. Ten minutes later, en route, the pain returns at the same intensity. His BP is 126/78. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名73岁男性在2剂硝酸甘油后胸痛完全缓解。10分钟后转运途中疼痛以相同强度再次出现，血压126/78。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Re-initiate the nitroglycerin component and continue assessment, treatment and vitals every 5 minutes
options.zh: 重新启动硝酸甘油部分，并每5分钟继续评估、处置和测量生命体征

options.en: Repeat both the nitroglycerin and the ASA components in full
options.zh: 完整重复硝酸甘油和阿司匹林两部分

options.en: Give Entonox instead, since nitroglycerin has already been used
options.zh: 改用Entonox，因为已经用过硝酸甘油

options.en: Give no further treatment, since 2 doses were already effective
options.zh: 不再给任何处置，因为2剂已经有效

questions.explanationEn: If pain is completely relieved for more than 5 minutes and then returns, you may re-initiate the nitroglycerin component of the chest pain protocol, but not the aspirin component; this counts as a new episode. Continue assessment, treatment and vitals every 5 minutes.
questions.explanationZh: 若疼痛完全缓解超过5分钟后再次出现，可重新启动胸痛方案的硝酸甘油部分，但不重复阿司匹林部分；这算作一次新发作。同时每5分钟继续评估、处置和测量生命体征。

questions.questionEn: What is the mechanism by which nitroglycerin relieves cardiac chest pain?
questions.questionZh: 硝酸甘油缓解心源性胸痛的机制是什么？

options.en: It blocks pain transmission in the spinal cord
options.zh: 阻断脊髓中的疼痛传导

options.en: It reduces cardiac oxygen demand by dilating vessels, decreasing preload and afterload, and dilates coronary arteries to increase blood flow to cardiac tissue
options.zh: 通过扩张血管降低心脏耗氧、减少前负荷和后负荷，并扩张冠状动脉以增加心肌血流

options.en: It prevents platelets from clumping together to form clots
options.zh: 防止血小板聚集形成血栓

options.en: It increases heart rate and contractility to improve output
options.zh: 通过提高心率和收缩力来改善心输出量

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin reduces cardiac oxygen demand primarily by dilating blood vessels, decreasing preload and afterload, and dilating coronary arteries to increase blood flow to cardiac tissue. Preventing platelet clumping describes ASA.
questions.explanationZh: 硝酸甘油主要通过扩张血管降低心脏耗氧，减少前负荷和后负荷，并扩张冠状动脉以增加心肌血流。防止血小板聚集描述的是阿司匹林。

questions.questionEn: A 77-year-old woman with chest pain is standing at her kitchen counter when you arrive. After the primary survey, what does the protocol direct regarding her position and movement?
questions.questionZh: 你到达时，一名77岁胸痛女性正站在厨房台面旁。完成初级评估后，方案对其体位和活动有何要求？

options.en: Have her walk to the stretcher to assess her exercise tolerance
options.zh: 让她自行走到担架旁以评估运动耐量

options.en: Lay her flat and elevate her legs
options.zh: 让她平卧并抬高双腿

options.en: Place her in a position of comfort as permitted by her clinical condition, and in general limit patient movement
options.zh: 在临床状况允许的前提下置于舒适体位，总体上限制患者活动

options.en: Keep her seated with legs hung down and delay transport until pain-free
options.zh: 让她坐位双腿下垂，等疼痛完全消失后再转运

questions.explanationEn: The chest pain protocol directs placing the patient in a position of comfort as permitted by clinical condition and, in general, limiting patient movement. Transport should be initiated immediately if able, delegating crew to prep egress.
questions.explanationZh: 胸痛方案要求在临床状况允许下将患者置于舒适体位，总体上限制其活动。若条件允许应立即启动转运，并指派队员准备搬运路线。

questions.questionEn: A 59-year-old man with chest pain has an SpO2 of 97% on room air. How should oxygen be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名59岁胸痛男性未吸氧时SpO2为97%。应如何给氧？

options.en: Apply a non-rebreather at 15 L/min to all cardiac chest pain patients
options.zh: 所有心源性胸痛患者一律使用15升/分非再呼吸面罩

options.en: Apply oxygen only as required to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94%; none is needed at 97%
options.zh: 仅在需要维持SpO2≥94%时给氧；97%时无需给氧

options.en: Apply nasal cannula at 6 L/min routinely
options.zh: 常规使用6升/分鼻导管

options.en: Withhold oxygen entirely regardless of the saturation
options.zh: 不论血氧饱和度如何一律不给氧

questions.explanationEn: The chest pain protocol directs completing a primary survey and applying oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94%. Routine high-flow oxygen in a normoxic cardiac patient is not indicated.
questions.explanationZh: 胸痛方案要求完成初级评估，并按需给氧以维持SpO2≥94%。对血氧正常的心脏病患者常规高流量给氧并无指征。

questions.questionEn: A 71-year-old man with cardiac chest pain becomes nauseated after his second nitroglycerin dose. As a PCP, what additional intervention may be considered?
questions.questionZh: 一名71岁心源性胸痛男性在第2剂硝酸甘油后出现恶心。作为PCP，可以考虑什么附加处置？

options.en: Dimenhydrinate for the nausea
options.zh: 给予苯海拉明茶碱（晕海宁）止吐

options.en: Ibuprofen 400 mg PO for the chest discomfort
options.zh: 口服400毫克布洛芬缓解胸部不适

options.en: Glucagon 1 mg IM
options.zh: 肌注1毫克胰高血糖素

options.en: Diphenhydramine 50 mg IV
options.zh: 静注50毫克苯海拉明

questions.explanationEn: Additional PCP interventions in the cardiac chest pain protocol are obtaining vascular access with running IV fluid and considering dimenhydrinate for nausea. Nausea and vomiting are recognized adverse effects of nitroglycerin.
questions.explanationZh: 心源性胸痛方案中PCP的附加处置为建立血管通路并输注液体，以及考虑用茶苯海明处理恶心。恶心呕吐是硝酸甘油已知的不良反应。

questions.questionEn: An 83-year-old woman with chest pain has a nitroglycerin patch already applied by her family, and her BP is 132/80 with HR 78. Your partner says the protocol cannot be used because she already has nitrates on board. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名83岁胸痛女性身上已被家人贴了硝酸甘油贴片，血压132/80，心率78。搭档说她体内已有硝酸盐，因此不能执行该方案。正确的说法是什么？

options.en: A nitro patch does not change the nitroglycerin protocol; proceed with 0.4 mg SL as indicated
options.zh: 贴片不改变硝酸甘油方案；按指征照常舌下给0.4毫克

options.en: The patch counts as one of the 3 permitted doses
options.zh: 贴片计入允许的3剂之一

options.en: Remove the patch and wait 30 minutes before any sublingual dose
options.zh: 揭掉贴片并等待30分钟后才能舌下给药

options.en: The protocol is contraindicated whenever a patch is in place
options.zh: 只要贴着贴片就禁用该方案

questions.explanationEn: If the patient has a nitro patch applied, it does not change the nitroglycerin protocol. The dose limit of 3 in any 30-minute period applies to your sublingual administrations and is counted irrespective of any nitro the patient took before your arrival, provided the systolic BP remains above 110 mmHg.
questions.explanationZh: 患者已贴硝酸甘油贴片不改变硝酸甘油方案。任何30分钟内最多3剂的上限针对的是你舌下给药的次数，且不计患者在你到达前自行使用的硝酸甘油，前提是收缩压持续高于110毫米汞柱。

questions.questionEn: Which medication in the BC guidelines does not require a set of vital signs prior to administration?
questions.questionZh: 在BC指南中，哪种药物在给药前不需要先测量生命体征？

options.en: Nitroglycerin
options.zh: 硝酸甘油

options.en: Entonox
options.zh: Entonox（氧化亚氮）

options.en: Aspirin (ASA)
options.zh: 阿司匹林

options.en: Epinephrine
options.zh: 肾上腺素

questions.explanationEn: ASA is the only medication for which vitals are not required prior to administration, though it should follow the rapid body survey and the cautions and contraindications must still be checked. Entonox specifically requires a baseline set of vitals including oxygen saturation.
questions.explanationZh: 阿司匹林是唯一在给药前不要求先测生命体征的药物，但仍应在快速全身检查之后给予，并必须核对注意事项和禁忌证。Entonox则明确要求先获得包括血氧饱和度在内的基线生命体征。

questions.questionEn: A 60-year-old man with chest pain has been on Entonox for 20 minutes after 3 nitroglycerin doses. Hospital arrival is not imminent. What does the guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 一名60岁胸痛男性在3剂硝酸甘油后已吸入Entonox 20分钟，短时间内无法到达医院。指南要求怎么做？

options.en: Continue Entonox for the remainder of the transport without change
options.zh: 整个转运过程继续吸入Entonox，不作调整

options.en: Discontinue Entonox, resume high-flow oxygen, and administer additional nitroglycerin as per protocol
options.zh: 停用Entonox，恢复高流量给氧，并按方案追加硝酸甘油

options.en: Administer a second 160 mg dose of ASA
options.zh: 再给160毫克阿司匹林一次

options.en: Give nitroglycerin at the same time as the Entonox for a combined effect
options.zh: 在吸Entonox的同时给硝酸甘油以求叠加效果

questions.explanationEn: If nitroglycerin has been given and Entonox is now in use, and hospital arrival is not imminent 20 minutes after the last nitro, discontinue Entonox, resume high-flow oxygen, and administer additional nitroglycerin as per protocol. The protocol may be repeated 30 minutes after the first nitro dose, after stopping nitrous oxide for 5 minutes.
questions.explanationZh: 若已给过硝酸甘油且正在使用Entonox，在最后一剂硝酸甘油后20分钟仍无法很快到院，应停用Entonox、恢复高流量给氧并按方案追加硝酸甘油。首剂硝酸甘油后30分钟，在停用氧化亚氮5分钟后可重复该方案。

questions.questionEn: A frail 86-year-old woman with chest pain is about to receive her first nitroglycerin dose while sitting on the edge of her bed. Which caution is most important?
questions.questionZh: 一名体弱的86岁胸痛女性正坐在床沿，即将接受第一剂硝酸甘油。最重要的注意事项是什么？

options.en: Nitroglycerin causes bradycardia in the elderly and requires atropine standby
options.zh: 硝酸甘油在老年人中会引起心动过缓，需备好阿托品

options.en: Hypotension frequently occurs, especially in the elderly, and must be expected; ensure she is not at risk of falling
options.zh: 低血压很常见，老年人尤甚，必须预料到；要确保她没有跌倒风险

options.en: Nitroglycerin spray should be shaken vigorously before use
options.zh: 硝酸甘油喷雾使用前应用力摇匀

options.en: The dose must be halved for patients over 80
options.zh: 80岁以上患者剂量必须减半

questions.explanationEn: Hypotension frequently occurs with nitroglycerin, especially in the elderly, and must be expected: ensure the patient is not at risk to fall. If using nitro spray, do not shake the container prior to administration.
questions.explanationZh: 硝酸甘油常引起低血压，老年人尤为明显，必须预先考虑到：要确保患者没有跌倒风险。使用硝酸甘油喷雾时，给药前不要摇动瓶身。

questions.questionEn: A 62-year-old man with cardiac chest pain has a heart rate of 158 and a BP of 118/76. What is the correct decision about nitroglycerin?
questions.questionZh: 一名62岁心源性胸痛男性心率158，血压118/76。关于硝酸甘油的正确决定是什么？

options.en: Withhold nitroglycerin: a heart rate above 150 is a contraindication
options.zh: 不给硝酸甘油：心率高于150是禁忌证

options.en: Give nitroglycerin, since the systolic BP is above 110 mmHg
options.zh: 给硝酸甘油，因为收缩压高于110毫米汞柱

options.en: Give nitroglycerin only after two doses of ASA
options.zh: 给两次阿司匹林之后再给硝酸甘油

options.en: Give a double dose of nitroglycerin to counter the tachycardia
options.zh: 给双倍剂量硝酸甘油以对抗心动过速

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin is contraindicated when the heart rate is below 50 or above 150, as well as with systolic BP below 110 mmHg, known nitrate allergy or sensitivity, and recent PDE-5 inhibitor use. The rest of the chest pain protocol still applies.
questions.explanationZh: 心率低于50或高于150时禁用硝酸甘油，此外收缩压低于110毫米汞柱、已知硝酸盐过敏或不耐受、近期使用过PDE-5抑制剂也均为禁忌。胸痛方案的其余部分仍应执行。

questions.questionEn: Under the cardiac chest pain protocol, at what point should transport be initiated?
questions.questionZh: 按心源性胸痛方案，应在什么时候启动转运？

options.en: Only after the patient is pain free
options.zh: 等患者疼痛完全消失后

options.en: Only after all three nitroglycerin doses are given
options.zh: 等三剂硝酸甘油全部给完后

options.en: Immediately if able, delegating crew members to prep egress if not; transport after the first nitroglycerin dose if not already moving
options.zh: 条件允许时立即转运，否则指派队员准备搬运路线；若尚未出发，至少在第一剂硝酸甘油后转运

options.en: Only after vascular access has been established
options.zh: 必须先建立血管通路后才转运

questions.explanationEn: The protocol directs initiating transport immediately if able to do so, delegating crew members to prep egress if not, and transporting after the first dose of nitroglycerin if not already done. On-scene time should not be extended for the full drug sequence.
questions.explanationZh: 方案要求条件允许时立即启动转运，否则指派队员准备搬运路线；若尚未出发，至少在第一剂硝酸甘油后转运。不应为完成整套给药流程而延长现场停留时间。

questions.questionEn: A 54-year-old man with chest pain tells you he took two of his own nitroglycerin tablets before you arrived, with no relief. His BP is 124/76 and HR 84. How many doses may you administer?
questions.questionZh: 一名54岁胸痛男性告诉你，在你到达前他已自行含服了两片自己的硝酸甘油但未缓解。血压124/76，心率84。你可以给几剂？

options.en: One dose only, since he has already had two
options.zh: 只能给一剂，因为他已经用过两片

options.en: None, because self-administered nitroglycerin blocks the protocol
options.zh: 一剂也不能给，因为自行服药后不能再执行该方案

options.en: Up to 3 doses in any 30-minute period, irrespective of any nitro taken prior to your arrival, provided the systolic BP remains above 110 mmHg
options.zh: 任何30分钟内最多3剂，不计其在你到达前自行服用的量，前提是收缩压持续高于110毫米汞柱

options.en: Unlimited doses as long as the pain continues
options.zh: 只要疼痛持续就可以不限剂数

questions.explanationEn: Repeat vitals and the drug until pain is relieved, to a maximum of 3 doses in any 30-minute period, providing the systolic BP remains above 110 mmHg, irrespective of any nitro taken by the patient prior to your arrival. Note that ASA is different: if the patient has already taken their recommended dose, ASA is contraindicated.
questions.explanationZh: 应重复测量生命体征并给药直至疼痛缓解，任何30分钟内最多3剂，前提是收缩压持续高于110毫米汞柱，且不计患者在你到达前自行服用的硝酸甘油。注意阿司匹林规则不同：若患者已自行服用推荐剂量，则禁用阿司匹林。

questions.questionEn: A 31-year-old man has a deep forearm laceration bleeding briskly after a workshop accident. What is your first hemorrhage control measure?
questions.questionZh: 一名31岁男性在车间事故中前臂深度撕裂伤，出血迅猛。你的第一项止血措施是什么？

options.en: Apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound immediately
options.zh: 立即在伤口近端上止血带

options.en: Pack the wound with hemostatic gauze
options.zh: 用止血纱布填塞伤口

options.en: Apply a cold pack and elevate the limb
options.zh: 冷敷并抬高患肢

options.en: Expose and examine the wound, then apply direct pressure
options.zh: 暴露并检查伤口，然后直接压迫

questions.explanationEn: In the primary survey, expose and examine, then control major hemorrhage with direct pressure, patient positioning and part positioning. Methods in order of preference are direct pressure, pressure dressing, positioning the part, positioning the patient, tourniquet, then wound packing.
questions.explanationZh: 在初级评估中应先暴露并检查伤口，然后以直接压迫、患者体位和肢体体位控制大出血。首选顺序为：直接压迫→加压包扎→抬高患部→摆放患者体位→止血带→伤口填塞。

questions.questionEn: A 10-year-old boy has an arterial bleed from a mid-thigh laceration. Direct pressure and a pressure dressing have failed to control it. What is the next step?
questions.questionZh: 一名10岁男孩大腿中段撕裂伤伴动脉性出血。直接压迫和加压包扎均未能控制出血。下一步是什么？

options.en: Pack the thigh wound and bandage over the packing
options.zh: 填塞大腿伤口并在填塞物上加压包扎

options.en: Elevate the limb and wait 5 minutes before reassessing
options.zh: 抬高患肢，等5分钟后再评估

options.en: Transport immediately without further hemorrhage control
options.zh: 立即转运，不再做其他止血处理

options.en: Apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound
options.zh: 在伤口近端上止血带

questions.explanationEn: If direct pressure does not control the bleeding and the wound is in an area amenable to tourniquet application, apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound. Wound packing is considered for junctional hemorrhage where a tourniquet cannot be applied.
questions.explanationZh: 若直接压迫无法控制出血，而伤口位于可上止血带的部位，应在伤口近端上止血带。伤口填塞用于无法使用止血带的交界区出血。

questions.questionEn: According to the BC wound care guideline, what is the correct order of preference for methods of hemorrhage control?
questions.questionZh: 按BC伤口护理指南，止血方法的正确优先顺序是什么？

options.en: Direct pressure, pressure dressing, positioning the part, positioning the patient, tourniquet, wound packing
options.zh: 直接压迫→加压包扎→抬高患部→摆放患者体位→止血带→伤口填塞

options.en: Tourniquet, direct pressure, wound packing, pressure dressing
options.zh: 止血带→直接压迫→伤口填塞→加压包扎

options.en: Wound packing, tourniquet, direct pressure, elevation
options.zh: 伤口填塞→止血带→直接压迫→抬高

options.en: Pressure points, elevation, tourniquet, direct pressure
options.zh: 压迫点→抬高→止血带→直接压迫

questions.explanationEn: The listed order is direct pressure, pressure dressing, positioning the part (elevation, only if it will not aggravate other injuries), positioning the patient (at rest and supine if injuries permit), tourniquet (note the time and do not release once applied), and extremity wound packing if the bleed cannot be controlled.
questions.explanationZh: 指南列出的顺序为：直接压迫→加压包扎→抬高患部（仅在不加重其他损伤时）→摆放患者体位（伤情允许时静卧仰卧）→止血带（记录时间，一旦上好不得松开）→出血仍无法控制时行肢体伤口填塞。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old man on warfarin has a deep laceration at the junction of the neck and shoulder that continues to bleed despite direct pressure. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名72岁服用华法林的男性在颈肩交界处有深度撕裂伤，直接压迫后仍持续出血。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Pack the wound firmly, since it is not amenable to a tourniquet
options.zh: 因无法使用止血带，用力填塞该伤口

options.en: Apply a tourniquet around the base of the neck
options.zh: 在颈根部上止血带

options.en: Release pressure every minute to assess whether bleeding has stopped
options.zh: 每分钟松开压迫一次以判断是否已止血

options.en: Continue and improve direct pressure with a pressure dressing; do not pack wounds on the neck, chest or abdomen
options.zh: 继续并加强直接压迫、加用加压包扎；颈部、胸部和腹部的伤口不得填塞

questions.explanationEn: Wound packing is considered for junctional hemorrhage not amenable to a tourniquet, but the guideline explicitly states: do not pack wounds on the neck, chest, or abdomen. Direct pressure and a pressure dressing remain the management here.
questions.explanationZh: 伤口填塞用于无法上止血带的交界区出血，但指南明确规定：颈部、胸部和腹部的伤口不得填塞。此例仍应以直接压迫和加压包扎处理。

questions.questionEn: You applied a tourniquet 12 minutes ago to a 14-year-old's forearm and the bleeding has stopped. Transport time is 25 minutes. What should you do with the tourniquet?
questions.questionZh: 你在12分钟前给一名14岁患者的前臂上了止血带，出血已经停止。转运时间还需25分钟。止血带应该如何处理？

options.en: Release it every 10 minutes to allow limb perfusion
options.zh: 每10分钟松开一次以让肢体获得灌注

options.en: Release it now that bleeding has stopped, and reapply if bleeding restarts
options.zh: 既然出血已停止就松开，再出血时重新上

options.en: Loosen it slightly to reduce pain, without fully releasing
options.zh: 稍微放松以减轻疼痛，但不完全松开

options.en: Leave it in place, having noted the time of application, and do not release it
options.zh: 记录上带时间后保持原位，不得松开

questions.explanationEn: Note the time of tourniquet application and do not release it once applied. Releasing a tourniquet risks renewed catastrophic hemorrhage and washout of metabolic products.
questions.explanationZh: 上止血带时应记录时间，一旦上好就不得松开。松开止血带有导致灾难性再出血和代谢产物冲刷入循环的风险。

questions.questionEn: What is the dose and administration of tranexamic acid (TXA) under the BC guidelines?
questions.questionZh: 按BC指南，氨甲环酸（TXA）的剂量和给药方法是什么？

options.en: 1 gram IV push over 10 seconds
options.zh: 1克静脉推注，10秒内推完

options.en: 2 grams (2000 mg) IV push over 1 minute
options.zh: 2克（2000毫克）静脉推注，1分钟内推完

options.en: 1 gram IM, repeated once after 30 minutes
options.zh: 肌注1克，30分钟后重复一次

options.en: 20 mg/kg IV infused over 20 minutes
options.zh: 20毫克/公斤静脉输注，20分钟输完

questions.explanationEn: TXA is delivered as 2 grams (2000 mg) IV push over 1 minute. Rapid administration risks further hypotension, which is the listed caution.
questions.explanationZh: TXA为2克（2000毫克）静脉推注，1分钟内推完。给药过快会加重低血压，这是指南列出的注意事项。

questions.questionEn: A 9-year-old girl struck by a car has signs of shock with ongoing internal bleeding suspected. The hypovolemia protocol has been initiated. What about TXA?
questions.questionZh: 一名9岁女孩被汽车撞伤，有休克表现并怀疑持续内出血，已启动低血容量方案。TXA该如何处理？

options.en: Give 1 gram IV, half the adult dose, adjusted for her age
options.zh: 按年龄调整，静脉给1克，即成人剂量的一半

options.en: Give the full 2 gram adult dose
options.zh: 按成人剂量给足2克

options.en: Give TXA only if the injury occurred more than 3 hours ago
options.zh: 仅在受伤超过3小时时才给TXA

options.en: Withhold TXA: patients under 12 years are a contraindication
options.zh: 不给TXA：12岁以下患者属于禁忌

questions.explanationEn: TXA contraindications are known hypersensitivity, more than 3 hours after injury, patients under 12 years, and isolated traumatic brain injuries. There is no reduced paediatric dose; the drug is simply not given below 12 years.
questions.explanationZh: TXA的禁忌证为：已知过敏、受伤超过3小时、12岁以下患者，以及孤立性颅脑损伤。该药没有儿科减量方案，12岁以下直接不予使用。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old man fell down stairs and was found by family 4 hours later. He has a rigid abdomen, BP 84/58 and HR 122. The hypovolemia protocol is under way. What about TXA?
questions.questionZh: 一名68岁男性从楼梯摔下，4小时后才被家人发现。腹部板状强直，血压84/58，心率122，已在执行低血容量方案。TXA该如何处理？

options.en: Give 2 grams IV push over 1 minute, since he is clearly in shock
options.zh: 因其明显休克，静脉推注2克，1分钟内推完

options.en: Give 2 grams IV as a slow infusion over 30 minutes instead
options.zh: 改为静脉缓慢输注2克，30分钟输完

options.en: Give 1 gram IV as a compromise given the delay
options.zh: 因延迟就诊折中给1克静脉推注

options.en: Withhold TXA: it is contraindicated more than 3 hours after injury
options.zh: 不给TXA：受伤超过3小时属于禁忌

questions.explanationEn: TXA is contraindicated if time is greater than 3 hours after injury. Continue the hypovolemia protocol: control hemorrhage, position supine, keep warm, oxygen to SpO2 ≥ 94%, vascular access and fluid boluses as clinically indicated.
questions.explanationZh: 受伤超过3小时后禁用TXA。应继续执行低血容量方案：控制出血、仰卧位、保暖、给氧维持SpO2≥94%、建立血管通路并按临床指征输液。

questions.questionEn: A 27-year-old man assaulted with a bat has an isolated head injury: GCS 10, a boggy scalp hematoma, BP 148/92, HR 62, no other injuries found on the rapid body survey. Your partner suggests TXA. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名27岁男性被球棒击打，为孤立性头部损伤：GCS 10分，头皮有波动性血肿，血压148/92，心率62，快速全身检查未发现其他损伤。搭档建议给TXA。正确的判断是什么？

options.en: Give TXA, since head bleeding is the most dangerous type of hemorrhage
options.zh: 给TXA，因为颅内出血是最危险的出血

options.en: Give TXA only after a fluid bolus raises the blood pressure
options.zh: 先输液升压后再给TXA

options.en: Withhold TXA: isolated traumatic brain injury is a contraindication, and he shows no signs of shock or hypovolemia
options.zh: 不给TXA：孤立性颅脑损伤是禁忌证，且他没有休克或低血容量表现

options.en: Give half the dose because he is hypertensive
options.zh: 因其血压偏高而给半量

questions.explanationEn: Isolated TBIs are a listed contraindication to TXA. His indications are also absent: TXA is for major trauma patients after initiation of the hypovolemia protocol, or signs of shock with a mechanism or findings suggestive of occult or ongoing bleeding. His hypertension with bradycardia suggests rising intracranial pressure, not hypovolemia.
questions.explanationZh: 孤立性颅脑损伤是TXA明确列出的禁忌证。且其适应证也不成立：TXA用于启动低血容量方案后的严重创伤患者，或有休克表现且受伤机制／体征提示隐匿性或持续性出血者。血压高伴心动过缓提示颅内压升高，而非低血容量。

questions.questionEn: A 12-year-old girl has a grossly deformed mid-shaft femur fracture with no palpable pulse in the foot. Bleeding is controlled. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名12岁女孩股骨干中段骨折伴明显畸形，足背触不到脉搏，出血已控制。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Splint the limb exactly as found and transport without any realignment
options.zh: 按发现时的原状固定肢体，不做任何复位即转运

options.en: Apply a tourniquet above the fracture to protect the limb
options.zh: 在骨折上方上止血带以保护肢体

options.en: Make repeated realignment attempts until a pulse returns
options.zh: 反复尝试复位直到脉搏恢复

options.en: Make one attempt to re-align the limb to the anatomical position; if circulation returns treat as stable, if it remains pulseless manage as unstable
options.zh: 尝试一次将肢体复位至解剖位；若循环恢复按稳定处理，若仍无脉搏则按不稳定处理

questions.explanationEn: Absence of distal circulation may indicate a limb-threatening injury. If the limb is pulseless distal to an injury, one attempt can be made to re-align it to the anatomical position. If circulation returns the patient can be treated as stable; if the limb remains pulseless the patient should be managed as unstable.
questions.explanationZh: 远端循环消失提示可能存在危及肢体的损伤。若损伤远端无脉搏，可尝试一次将肢体复位至解剖位。若循环恢复可按稳定患者处理；若仍无脉搏则应按不稳定患者处理。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old woman fell at home and has an unstable pelvis, BP 86/54, HR 118, pale cool skin. External bleeding is controlled and the pelvis has been bound. How should she be positioned and protected?
questions.questionZh: 一名79岁女性在家跌倒，骨盆不稳定，血压86/54，心率118，皮肤苍白湿冷。外出血已控制且骨盆已固定。应如何摆放体位并做好防护？

options.en: Sitting upright with legs hung down
options.zh: 端坐位，双腿下垂

options.en: Semi-prone on her left side
options.zh: 左侧半俯卧位

options.en: Prone with the head turned to the side
options.zh: 俯卧并将头偏向一侧

options.en: Supine to support blood pressure, kept warm and protected from further heat loss, with oxygen to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94%
options.zh: 仰卧以支持血压，注意保暖并防止进一步热量丢失，给氧维持SpO2≥94%

questions.explanationEn: Hypovolemia management at all licence levels: control external hemorrhage, splint pelvis or fractures if indicated, position the patient supine to support blood pressure, keep warm and protect from further heat loss, and administer oxygen to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94%.
questions.explanationZh: 各级执照的低血容量处理：控制外出血，按指征固定骨盆或骨折，仰卧位以支持血压，保暖并防止进一步热量丢失，给氧维持SpO2≥94%。

questions.questionEn: What is the fluid bolus regimen for a hypovolemic patient under the PCP scope?
questions.questionZh: 在PCP范围内，低血容量患者的液体推注方案是什么？

options.en: 10 ml/kg to a maximum of 1 litre, reassessing every 250 ml
options.zh: 10毫升/公斤，最多1升，每250毫升复评一次

options.en: 1 litre wide open, then reassess once
options.zh: 1升全速输入后复评一次

options.en: 500 ml regardless of weight, no repeat
options.zh: 不论体重一律500毫升，不重复

options.en: 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml
options.zh: 20毫升/公斤，最多2升，每500毫升复评一次

questions.explanationEn: The fluid bolus is 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml. In the nausea and vomiting protocol the same bolus regimen is used, targeting a systolic blood pressure of 90 mmHg.
questions.explanationZh: 液体推注为20毫升/公斤，最多2升，每500毫升复评一次。恶心呕吐方案采用同样的推注方案，目标收缩压为90毫米汞柱。

questions.questionEn: A 6-year-old boy has scald burns to 25% of his body surface area. He is alert with BP 96/60 and HR 130. Which BC guideline applies?
questions.questionZh: 一名6岁男孩烫伤面积占体表25%，神志清醒，血压96/60，心率130。适用哪一项BC指南？

options.en: None, because his blood pressure is normal for his age
options.zh: 都不适用，因为其血压对该年龄属正常

options.en: Only the wound care guideline, since burns are wounds
options.zh: 只适用伤口护理指南，因为烧伤属于伤口

options.en: The CPAP guideline, to support oxygenation
options.zh: CPAP指南，用于支持氧合

options.en: The hypovolemia guideline: patients with burns greater than 20% BSA (partial and full thickness) are a listed indication
options.zh: 低血容量指南：体表面积超过20%的（部分及全层）烧伤患者是其列出的适应证

questions.explanationEn: Patients with burns greater than 20% BSA (partial and full thickness) are a listed indication for the hypovolemia protocol, alongside hypovolemia with systolic BP < 90 mmHg and other clinical signs of shock. Initiate cooling of major burns and protect against heat loss.
questions.explanationZh: 体表面积超过20%的（部分及全层）烧伤患者是低血容量方案列出的适应证之一，与收缩压<90毫米汞柱的低血容量及其他休克体征并列。大面积烧伤应开始降温处理并注意防止热量丢失。

questions.questionEn: An 81-year-old man was ejected from a rolled vehicle. He has a flail segment, an open femur fracture and BP 112/70 with HR 98. Your partner says the hypovolemia protocol does not apply because his systolic is above 90. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名81岁男性在车辆翻滚中被抛出车外，有连枷胸段、股骨开放性骨折，血压112/70，心率98。搭档说收缩压高于90，因此低血容量方案不适用。正确的判断是什么？

options.en: The protocol may be used with a BP above 90 mmHg if shock is anticipated because of the mechanism, the nature and extent of the injuries, or the patient's condition
options.zh: 若根据受伤机制、损伤性质与范围或患者状况预计会发生休克，血压高于90毫米汞柱时也可使用该方案

options.en: The protocol is strictly limited to a systolic below 90 mmHg
options.zh: 该方案严格限于收缩压低于90毫米汞柱者

options.en: Wait for a second set of vitals showing hypotension before acting
options.zh: 等到第二组生命体征显示低血压后再处理

options.en: Use the protocol only once the heart rate exceeds 120
options.zh: 只有心率超过120时才启用该方案

questions.explanationEn: The footnote to the hypovolemia protocol states it may be used for patients with BP greater than 90 mmHg if shock is anticipated because of the mechanism of injury, the nature and extent of the injuries, or the patient's condition. Waiting for hypotension in a multi-system trauma patient means acting late.
questions.explanationZh: 低血容量方案的注释明确指出：若根据受伤机制、损伤性质与范围或患者状况预计会发生休克，血压高于90毫米汞柱的患者也可使用该方案。对多系统创伤患者等到出现低血压再处理就太迟了。

questions.questionEn: Which findings are listed indications for the BC hypovolemia guideline?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪组表现是BC低血容量指南列出的适应证？

options.en: Fever, tachypnea and a productive cough
options.zh: 发热、呼吸增快和咳痰

options.en: Chest pain relieved by rest with a normal blood pressure
options.zh: 休息后缓解的胸痛且血压正常

options.en: Wheezing with accessory muscle use and a normal blood pressure
options.zh: 喘鸣伴辅助呼吸肌参与且血压正常

options.en: Hypovolemia with systolic BP < 90 mmHg plus other clinical signs or symptoms of shock, or burns > 20% BSA
options.zh: 低血容量伴收缩压<90毫米汞柱及其他休克体征或症状，或体表面积>20%的烧伤

questions.explanationEn: The indications are patients with all of: hypovolemia, systolic BP < 90 mmHg, and other clinical signs or symptoms of shock; plus patients with burns greater than 20% BSA (partial and full thickness). Evidence of significant blood or body fluid loss is needed to support the diagnosis of hypovolemia.
questions.explanationZh: 适应证为同时具备低血容量、收缩压<90毫米汞柱以及其他休克体征或症状的患者，另加体表面积超过20%的（部分及全层）烧伤患者。诊断低血容量需要有明显血液或体液丢失的证据支持。

questions.questionEn: A 2-week-old infant has been vomiting for 3 days and now has cool mottled skin and a weak rapid pulse. He is wet and exposed on the assessment surface. Beyond oxygenation, which intervention is essential?
questions.questionZh: 一名2周大的婴儿呕吐已3天，现皮肤湿冷花斑、脉搏细速。他身上潮湿且暴露在检查台上。除了氧合之外，哪项处置最为关键？

options.en: Position him sitting upright with the legs hung down
options.zh: 让其端坐、双腿下垂

options.en: Dry him and keep him warm, protecting from further heat loss
options.zh: 擦干并保暖，防止进一步热量丢失

options.en: Apply a tourniquet-style pressure wrap to the limbs
options.zh: 在四肢缠绕止血带式加压绷带

options.en: Administer TXA 2 grams IV
options.zh: 静脉给予2克TXA

questions.explanationEn: Keeping the patient warm and protecting from further heat loss is a core intervention at all licence levels for hypovolemia, and neonates lose heat extremely rapidly. Sitting upright is for CHF/pulmonary edema, and TXA is contraindicated under 12 years.
questions.explanationZh: 保暖并防止进一步热量丢失是各级执照处理低血容量的核心措施，而新生儿散热极快。端坐位适用于心衰／肺水肿，TXA则在12岁以下属禁忌。

questions.questionEn: A 15-year-old boy with a stab wound to the thigh has BP 88/56, HR 128 and pale clammy skin. Bleeding is controlled with a tourniquet. As a PCP, when should vascular access and fluid be obtained?
questions.questionZh: 一名15岁男孩大腿刺伤，血压88/56，心率128，皮肤苍白湿冷，已用止血带控制出血。作为PCP，应在什么时候建立血管通路并输液？

options.en: On scene, before packaging, so the bolus is complete before moving
options.zh: 在现场、打包前完成，以便搬动前输完

options.en: Only after arrival at hospital
options.zh: 到达医院后才做

options.en: Before controlling the hemorrhage
options.zh: 在控制出血之前

options.en: En route, or during a time delay, after hemorrhage control and packaging
options.zh: 在控制出血并打包之后，于转运途中或遇到延误时进行

questions.explanationEn: Additional PCP interventions for hypovolemia are performed en route or during a time delay: obtain vascular access, consider a fluid bolus of 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres reassessing every 500 ml, and consider TXA where indicated. On-scene time should not be extended for IV access.
questions.explanationZh: 低血容量的PCP附加处置应在转运途中或遇到延误时进行：建立血管通路，按指征考虑20毫升/公斤（最多2升、每500毫升复评）的液体推注，并考虑使用TXA。不应为建立静脉通路而延长现场时间。

questions.questionEn: A 30 kg 9-year-old in hypovolemic shock is receiving a fluid bolus. What volume constitutes the correct bolus, and how often should you reassess?
questions.questionZh: 一名30公斤重的9岁低血容量休克患儿正在接受液体推注。正确的推注量是多少，多久复评一次？

options.en: 300 ml, reassessing at the end of the bolus
options.zh: 300毫升，输完后复评

options.en: 1500 ml, reassessing every 500 ml
options.zh: 1500毫升，每500毫升复评一次

options.en: 2000 ml, reassessing at the end of the bolus
options.zh: 2000毫升，输完后复评

options.en: 600 ml (20 ml/kg), reassessing every 500 ml
options.zh: 600毫升（20毫升/公斤），每500毫升复评一次

questions.explanationEn: The bolus is 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres: 30 kg x 20 ml = 600 ml, with reassessment every 500 ml. Reassessment between increments prevents over-resuscitation.
questions.explanationZh: 推注量为20毫升/公斤，最多2升：30公斤×20毫升＝600毫升，每500毫升复评一次。分段复评可避免液体复苏过量。

questions.questionEn: A 13-year-old with multiple injuries and signs of shock has an open abdominal wound with a loop of bowel protruding. How should the eviscerated bowel be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名13岁多发伤患者有休克表现，腹部开放伤口有一段肠管脱出。脱出的肠管应如何处理？

options.en: Gently replace it in the abdominal cavity and bandage firmly
options.zh: 轻柔地将其放回腹腔并加压包扎

options.en: Cover it with moist sterile dressings followed by an occlusive layer, and do not place it back in the abdominal cavity
options.zh: 用湿润无菌敷料覆盖后再加一层封闭敷料，不要将其放回腹腔

options.en: Pack the abdominal wound to control bleeding
options.zh: 填塞腹部伤口以控制出血

options.en: Apply a dry pressure dressing directly over the bowel
options.zh: 直接在肠管上加干性加压包扎

questions.explanationEn: Cover extruded bowel or eviscerated abdominal contents with moist, sterile dressings followed by an occlusive layer, and do not place them back in the abdominal cavity. Also control external hemorrhage, limit movement to reduce clot disruption, protect against heat loss and use a position of comfort. Wounds on the abdomen must not be packed.
questions.explanationZh: 脱出的肠管或腹腔内容物应以湿润无菌敷料覆盖，外加一层封闭敷料，且不得放回腹腔。同时控制外出血、限制活动以免血凝块脱落、防止热量丢失并保持舒适体位。腹部伤口不得填塞。

questions.questionEn: A 66-year-old woman thrown from a horse 40 minutes ago has BP 88/60, HR 124, a rigid abdomen and no external bleeding. The hypovolemia protocol has been initiated and vascular access obtained. What additional PCP intervention should be considered?
questions.questionZh: 一名66岁女性40分钟前从马背摔下，血压88/60，心率124，腹部板状强直，无外出血。低血容量方案已启动且血管通路已建立。应考虑哪项PCP附加处置？

options.en: Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL for the abdominal pain
options.zh: 舌下含服0.4毫克硝酸甘油以缓解腹痛

options.en: Ipratropium 500 mcg via nebulizer
options.zh: 雾化吸入500微克异丙托溴铵

options.en: CPAP at 5 cmH2O to support oxygenation
options.zh: 给予5厘米水柱CPAP以支持氧合

options.en: Tranexamic acid, indicated in shock secondary to blood loss and hypovolemia secondary to occult bleeding
options.zh: 氨甲环酸，适用于失血所致休克及隐匿性出血所致低血容量

questions.explanationEn: Consider tranexamic acid in cases of shock secondary to blood loss and hypovolemia secondary to occult bleeding. She is within 3 hours of injury, over 12 years of age, and has no isolated TBI, so no contraindication applies. Dose is 2 grams IV push over 1 minute.
questions.explanationZh: 失血所致休克及隐匿性出血导致的低血容量应考虑使用氨甲环酸。该患者受伤在3小时内、年龄超过12岁、无孤立性颅脑损伤，故无禁忌。剂量为2克静脉推注，1分钟内推完。
